DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum (PG)

The description of a painful ulcer with a central necrotic base, purplish irregular borders, and a history of an ant bite (pathergy) in a patient with Crohn's disease and diabetes is highly suggestive of PG. The presence of pitting edema and varicose veins supports an inflammatory etiology often triggered by minor trauma or underlying systemic disease.
